settings.heading: The 30-day guarantee.
settings.lede: If your first order isn't for you, tell us within 30 days and we'll refund it.

settings.heading: How it works
settings.body:
Email us within 30 days of delivery on your first order and we'll refund it. No return shipment required — please don't post an opened food product back to us.

This wording is pending final legal sign-off. The terms above are the working version and will be confirmed before launch.

settings.heading: Damaged or wrong item
settings.body: Send a photo and your order number and we'll replace it, whichever order it is. That isn't limited to first orders and isn't limited to 30 days.
